label: Copy Content
description: Copies whatever the event names as its source into the resource this step acts on: the one an earlier step created, or else the target. An event naming no source copies nothing, so a workflow can offer copying as an option.

sourceType.label: Source type
sourceType.description: The resource type a source must have, e.g. "wf/WorkflowVersion". Left blank, a source of any type is copied.

skipProperties.label: Skip properties
skipProperties.description: Properties of the source itself that are not copied, such as a label the copy has its own of.

dropTagCategories.label: Drop tag categories
dropTagCategories.description: Tag categories whose tags on the source are not copied, such as where the source stands in its lifecycle.
